meta.method: manual; every mapping annotation in the frame read from source, then machine-verified against the files by validate.py
meta.scope: src/main only; src/test, target/, build/ excluded

frame.how_candidates_were_found: grep for @RequestMapping/@GetMapping/@PostMapping/@PutMapping/@DeleteMapping/@PatchMapping over all 264 files of the module returned exactly 8; the remaining 256 are generated DTO/model classes. Each of the 8 was read and every mapping annotation in it transcribed.
frame.why_this_frame: This module holds the Berlin Group PSD2 server API, and it is where CIMET and the LLM-style audit disagree by an order of magnitude (CIMET 10-12 endpoints for the whole system, the audit 153). Labelling it exhaustively makes recall computable for the disputed area. The frame is a deliberate probe, not a random sample: results generalise to this module, not to the whole system.
frame.not_in_frame: The rest of the repository is not labeled. In particular consent-management (26 further interfaces, ~122 mapping annotations), aspsp-profile, certificate-generator, xs2a-vop-api and the directly-annotated endpoints in xs2a-impl are outside this ground truth. Numbers here must never be presented as system-wide.

services.name: xs2a-impl
services.note: Service attribution rule: the endpoints are DECLARED in the xs2a-server-api module but SERVED by the controllers in xs2a-impl that implement those interfaces. The service is the serving one, because that is the deployable unit the IR describes. The declaring module is recorded per entry in declaring_module. The serves_modules list records which module directories hold declarations served by this service; it is what lets an extractor's file path be resolved back to a service without hand-mapping.

declaration_pattern.summary: Every endpoint in this frame is declared by a @RequestMapping on a default method of a Java interface, and implemented by a controller class in a different module that carries no mapping annotation of its own.
declaration_pattern.handler_naming: The annotated handler is underscore-prefixed (_getAccountList); an unannotated sibling of the same name without the underscore (getAccountList) is the method the controller overrides. Both names are recorded, because an extractor may reasonably report either.
declaration_pattern.why_it_matters: CIMET reports 12 endpoints for the entire xs2a system and 3 for xs2a-impl. None of the 50 below is among them. Two separate causes were confirmed: (1) xs2a-server-api is not one of the 12 modules CIMET recognises as a microservice, so the file is never scanned; (2) the implementing controllers in xs2a-impl carry no mapping annotation, so scanning them yields nothing either. The endpoints are therefore lost twice over.

excluded.reason: Outside the frame. Note the consequence: the 12 endpoints CIMET does find are exactly the ones this ground truth does not cover, and the 50 this ground truth covers are exactly the ones CIMET does not find. The two sets are disjoint, so precision against this frame is not meaningful for CIMET — only recall is. This is stated in the evaluation report rather than hidden in a single F1 number.
